trust_decision.summary: A file path supplied by an MCP tool caller (export_state/import_state filepath, saveVectorToFile file_path, solveTrueSublinear vector_file) goes to fs write/read with no containment. The fix allows only a basename and confines it to a dedicated state or vector directory, in the library methods that do the file I/O.

landing_point.why: The summary names consciousness-explorer export_state; the MCP handler at src/consciousness-explorer/mcp/server.js:529 forwards args.filepath straight to exportState, which calls fs.writeFileSync(filepath).

fix_sites.entry_point: consciousness-explorer MCP tool export_state (src/consciousness-explorer/mcp/server.js:305-306); also the CLI `export <filepath>` (src/consciousness-explorer/bin/cli.js:353-361) and the public ConsciousnessExplorer.exportState API
export_state / import_state tool inputSchema (advisory hint only, pattern/maxLength)

fix_sites.module_kind: second implementation in another package (main MCP server)

fix_sites.entry_point: main MCP tool solveTrueSublinear, parameter vector_file (src/mcp/server.ts:414-415 -> 936-938)
fix_sites.module_kind: second implementation, read side, reached through a different solver tool

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/mcp/server.ts:1248-1275 (saveVectorToFile write) and src/mcp/server.ts:1176-1184 (vector_file read via solveTrueSublinear at src/mcp/server.ts:936-938). This is a separate MCP server in the root package, away from src/consciousness-explorer (its own package.json).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory names consciousness-explorer export_state, while saveVectorToFile/vector_file are in the main solver MCP server in a different package, so a solver could argue they are a separate product and that the vector_file read is a 'documented feature for large vectors' (src/mcp/server.ts:265), not a write.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Round trips must keep working: saveVectorToFile with a basename followed by solveTrueSublinear vector_file with the same name, and export_state followed by import_state. Format detection by extension (.json/.csv/.txt, plus the explicit format override) must also keep working. A fix that rejects every name, drops the extension, or confines save and load to different directories breaks these round trips.

O6_input_shapes: Windows reserved device names (CON, NUL, COM1...)
symlink planted at the final component (O_NOFOLLOW)

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The method already exists, takes a caller path, and sits next to export_state in the same package; a maintainer adding a 'export proof for external verification' tool would wire it the same way.
